home.title:
Content operations.
Digital platforms.
home.intro: I'm Livi. I work with teams whose content is hard to find, hard to reuse, or risky to publish. The projects here are the models and workflows I use to get that under control.

about.title:
A systems mind,
a human touch.
about.lede: Content operations, CMS, DAM and digital platforms.
about.body: I work with editors to map how content moves, then leave a model and a workflow they can run without me.

principles.title: Start with the editors
principles.body: I sit with the people who publish and watch them do a real task before I change anything.

principles.title: Name an owner
principles.body: Every record gets a person who can change it, a reason to exist and a way to retire it.

principles.title: Leave it easy to run
principles.body: The next owner should be able to find the source of truth without calling me.

contact.title: Get in touch.
contact.lede: For content operations and digital platform enquiries.
contact.subject: Content & digital platform enquiry

home.title:
DJ sets.
Behind the decks.
home.intro: Livicee is the DJ side of me. Five mixes, from the slow open to the wind-down.

about.title: About Livicee.
about.body: Same person, different collection. I pick for the room first: the hour, who is there, how much space the music needs. Files go on when I have them to share.

principles.title: Read the room
principles.body: The hour and who is there decide the record, not a genre label.

principles.title: Leave room for a turn
principles.body: A set that only plays what people already know gets dull, so I keep a path open for something they didn’t expect.

principles.title: Think in hours
principles.body: Each selection here is a stretch of the night and where it goes next.
